name: @zoltar/open-oracle-arbitrager
description: Independent OpenOracle monitoring and arbitrage execution service

scripts.lint: bun x @biomejs/biome lint package.json tsconfig.json bunfig.toml src tests scripts docs/*.ts config && bun ../../tooling/repo/lint-no-restricted-import-types.mts .
scripts.format: bun x @biomejs/biome format --write biome.json package.json tsconfig.json bunfig.toml README.md src tests scripts docs/*.ts docs/*.html docs/*.css docs/*.json config && bun x prettier --write 'contracts/**/*.sol'
scripts.format:check: bun x @biomejs/biome format biome.json package.json tsconfig.json bunfig.toml README.md src tests scripts docs/*.ts docs/*.html docs/*.css docs/*.json config && bun x prettier --check 'contracts/**/*.sol'
scripts.check: bun run typecheck && bun run lint && bun run check:generated && bun run test && bun run check:docs && bun run format:check
